engineering_composition.verdict: Both engineering ceilings remain above these conservative compositions of the current table bounds. They are not literal datasheet frequency intervals or independently measured frequencies.
engineering_composition.full_range_conditions: Revision V factory-calibrated HSI, unchanged default HSITRIM64, actual stable HSI-derived clock/divider selection verified by its exclusive owner, VDD1.62..3.6V and TJ-40..applicable TJmax. Clock ownership must prevent concurrent trim or topology changes.
engineering_composition.qualification_limit: Combining separately characterized/design/test table terms is an engineering bound, not a new joint-condition production guarantee, jitter/WCET claim or HIL measurement.

voltage_temperature_limits.suffix6_ambient: -40..85C at maximum power dissipation; to105C only at low-power dissipation with TJ limit respected. Junction and ambient ranges are not interchangeable.
voltage_temperature_limits.VOS0_LDO: TJmax105C, CPUmax480MHz, minimumVDDLDO1.7V; no permission to extend another profile beyond its operating constraints.
voltage_temperature_limits.note: These operating constraints qualify applicability of the oscillator envelope, not an independent approval of arbitrary clock/power configurations or suffix3 operation.

trim_identity.reference: Existing controlled RM0433 Rev9 section8.7.4 p388; available only on revision V devices.
trim_identity.HSICAL: bits11:0 is the sum of factory engineering Option Bytes and HSITRIM; hardware loads factory calibration at reset.
trim_identity.boundary: 64 is the user trim offset/reset setting, not the raw HSICAL value or an independent absolute frequency. RevisionY uses RCC_ICSCR with different layout and reset0x20; this V-cut evidence cannot be transplanted to Y.
